players.product: Hyperscale AI data-center campus with behind-the-meter power (Project Matador, Texas): powered land, powered shell and turnkey data centers leased to AI compute tenants (first tenant TensorWave, 222 MW initial phase)

quarterly_data.signal: Fermi's Q2 2026 results release and investor presentation (8-K exhibits) on Project Matador's path to power: approximately 8,400 acres secured or under long-term lease; the three Siemens F-class turbines that arrived at the Port of Houston in July bring Fermi's landed power assets to 1.5 GW. Path to first power: about 200 megawatts of initial commercial power over the next six months and about 1.5 GW over the next 18 to 24 months, excluding the Hillcore alliance and subject to binding customer agreements and approvals. Site infrastructure: more than 11 miles of perimeter fencing, nearly five miles of high-pressure natural gas pipeline and seven miles of water distribution lines providing 2.5 million gallons per day for closed-loop cooling that will use 80% less water than traditional methods, backed by a two-million-gallon storage tank. A deck footnote says the 4.8 GW of power within ~30 months includes the Hillcore strategic alliance, 200MW of power from Xcel Energy, and six SGT-800 turbines on order and expected to be delivered in 2028.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 8,400 acres; landed power assets 1.5 GW; about 200 megawatts over the next six months; about 1.5 GW over the next 18 to 24 months

quarterly_data.signal: Deal terms stated in Fermi's Q2 2026 release and deck: the TensorWave lease (Fermi's first customer) has a 15-year initial term with two 5-year extension options, with phased delivery beginning in 2H 2027. Under the Hillcore build-own-operate-transfer alliance (approximately 2.6 GW of combined-cycle generation owned by Hillcore, bringing total planned on-site generation to 4.8 GW within approximately 30 months), Fermi is the anchor offtaker under a 20-year power purchase agreement renewable in 10-year increments, first power of approximately 350 MW is targeted within 24 months of notice to proceed, and Fermi commits no capital and issues no debt for the plant.
quarterly_data.figure: TensorWave: 15-year initial term, two 5-year extension options, phased delivery from 2H 2027; Hillcore: 20-year PPA, approximately 350 MW first power within 24 months of NTP

quarterly_data.signal: Fermi's Q2 2026 financial highlights (8-K release): $185.0 million of capital invested in property, plant and equipment in the quarter, bringing the gross balance to approximately $1.55 billion; net loss of $25.8 million, or $0.04 per basic and diluted share, driven mostly by general and administrative expenses of $26.8 million; $91.7 million of total cash and restricted cash at June 30, 2026. The company remains pre-revenue and in its development phase, so spending tracks buildout rather than operations.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 PP&E investment $185.0 million (gross approximately $1.55 billion); net loss $25.8 million; G&A $26.8 million; cash and restricted cash $91.7 million
